notes.title: One Week After Launch | 12,000+ Units, Press Reviews, Steam Deck, and More!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]Thank you so much for your very generous and kind support for this tiny game. Creating this story took a whole year of writing, drawing, and planning (+ many more years of processing my accumulated housing trauma)[/p][p][/p][p]I’m so happy to see that the game is resonating with people. More than 12,000 people have added the game to their libraries, and the game currently has a 100% positive review score. <3[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Reviews and Press[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665457/17b8379cd6d1fcf2fae4abe5745d55132ad4e434.png"][/img][/p][p]The wonderful folks at [i]Rock Paper Shotgun[/i] wrote a [url="https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/dont-get-your-hopes-up-is-all-architectural-horror-human-warmth-and-unnervingly-stoic-pigeons"]thoughtful reflection on the game[/url], and it was featured on both my favourite [url="https://warpdoor.com/2025/09/21/dont-get-your-hopes-up/"]Warp Door blog[/url] and the unexpected pages of Amsterdam’s [url="https://www.parool.nl/amsterdam/videospel-over-de-amsterdamse-woningmarkt-je-strijdt-tegen-een-soort-onzichtbare-vijand~bfc9bc8b/"]Het Parool newspaper[/url] (paywalled).[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Steam Deck Compatibility[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665457/0925e4270a423557c6430329809045ac6cae63c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Since a few folks have asked, I can confirm that [i]Don’t Get Your Hopes Up[/i] works great on a Steam Deck, and is fully playable from beginning to end. Sections that require drag / scroll / mouse input translate seamlessly to the Deck’s touch screen, and the game uses the Ren’Py engine’s in-built controller support for controls. [/p][p]Those maps of Amsterdam really pop if you have an OLED Deck. :)[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Thank You for Playing[/b] [/h2][p]Keep those Steam reviews coming, and I would love to hear from you if the game spoke to you in any way, or if you have any critiques or questions. If you’d like to share, I’d also love to hear your own stories of housing precarity – wherever you may be in the world. You can [url="https://www.krishcat.com"]reach me via the email[/url] address on my website.[/p][p][/p][p]With much love and gratitude,[/p][p]Krish  // Gobi65 Games[/p]

notes.title: Don't Get Your Hopes Up Releases 16 September 2025!
notes.content:
[h3][b]🎉 Don't Get Your Hopes Up is out Tuesday September 16![/b][/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The game will be free to play. I would love for all of you to try it out and leave a review if you can, or share with someone who might resonate with a weird, disquieting non-fiction videogame whose horror is all-too-relevant anywhere in the world. <3
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665457/b221a9f0f91f17454c237005b30336262778ad05.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665457/27e787c3fc7848e1ab3e7a6ac0348db749c7607b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665457/3f285191f50b49c799c07d6b8f7477a66b457942.png"][/img][/p][p]I'm also deeply humbled to reveal that the game is an official selection for the [url="https://www.asff.co.uk/"]Aesthetica Game Lab at the Aesthetica Short Film Festival[/url]​ 2025, and for the 2025 [url="https://www.gamedevsofcolor.org/"]Game Devs of Color Expo[/url]​ . Being at GDoC is a dream - to even think that making a game was possible for someone like me is a direct result of the spaces they've built. [/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Until next week, thanks for following along! [/p][p align="start"]
🕹️ Playtime: 40-60 minutes
🆓 Free on Steam
🎮 Steam Deck-compatible 
🙏🏽 Any reviews, ratings, wishlists or shares appreciated![/p]
